thread:
Noelle Park: hi everyone, first day here! trying to run the quickstart in europe-west2 but getting permission denied when listing instances. not sure who owns regional vs billing perms. :wave:

Noelle Park: gcloud output:
```
ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.list) PERMISSION_DENIED: User does not have permission to list instances on project redwood-eu-ghost
```

Noelle Park: also in AWS i can't view the billing console — it says AccessDenied. i'm guessing SSO mapping but not sure which group to ask for. :confused:

dan_it: welcome Noelle! :tada: quickcheck — did onboarding add you to `engineering` only? EU projects need membership in `infra-eu` (or `infra-admins`) for viewer roles. Billing requires `billing-viewers` or `billing.viewer` on the billing account.

Noelle Park: i only got "engineering" from the SSO invite. i filled the onboarding checklist but didn't see infra-eu listed.

leo_cloud: hey Noelle — a common gotcha: if you were added to `infra-global` but we have an org Policy that restricts some folder-level grants, that can block project access in EU folders. Can you paste your project ancestors?

Noelle Park: running:`gcloud projects get-ancestors redwood-eu-ghost --format="value(ancestor)"`

Noelle Park: output:
```
organizations/9876543210
folders/4444444
projects/redwood-eu-ghost
```

leo_cloud: that folder id 4444444 is the eu-shared folder — good. Next, check IAM membership with this (after a few minutes of SSO propagation):
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-eu-ghost --filter=bindings.members:noelle.park@redwood.com --format=json
```

Noelle Park: pasting result: `[]`

dan_it: ok not added yet. i'll open a ticket to add you to `infra-eu` and the billing-viewers SSO group. infra-bot will track it.

infra-bot: Ticket ONB-924 created by dan_it for user Noelle Park — "Add infra-eu + billing-viewers". Priority: P2. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-924

leo_cloud: two quick unblocks while IT works: 1) i can grant a temp `roles/compute.viewer` on the project for 2 hours, 2) if billing is still AccessDenied we can ask ops to link the project to the billing account — sometimes projects get created without the folder-level billing inheritance.

leo_cloud: granted `roles/compute.viewer` on project redwood-eu-ghost to noelle.park@redwood.com (expires in 2h).

Noelle Park: wow listing works now, i can see the test VM and run the smoke. huge help, thanks! :relieved:

Noelle Park: AWS billing still blocked — shows "You don't have access to this billing account".

dan_it: ops-bot, can you check whether redwood-eu-ghost is linked to billingAccounts/7788-9900-1122 and if not attach it?\\n\nops-bot: Billing check for project redwood-eu-ghost: not currently linked to any billing account. Submitted request OP-431 to link to billingAccounts/7788-9900-1122. ETA: up to 30 minutes after approval.

Noelle Park: thanks — curious: will moving folder or linking billing change my current temp role? i have collaborators on the project for the tutorial.

leo_cloud: project-level roles should stay intact; linking billing won't change IAM. Moving a project between folders can change inherited policies — ops will snapshot IAM before any move. i'll note that on OP-431.

dan_it: small onboarding doc suggestion from this case: add step "confirm project ancestors and billing link; if project created outside shared folder or missing billing link, file ops ticket" and include the two CLI commands we used. saves ~20m for new hires.

Noelle Park: adding to my checklist. thanks again everyone, excited to be here! :sparkles:
